issues.sym: The air conditioning slowly stops cooling and needs recharging again and again, sometimes every year.
issues.why: The A/C condenser at the front of the car can develop leaks. Honda sent owners a letter and extended the condenser warranty to 10 years from the original purchase date with unlimited miles.
issues.next: If your A/C is weak, go to a Honda dealer and ask about the condenser warranty extension (bulletin 21-017) before paying for a recharge.

issues.sym: A charging system warning, a 12-volt battery that keeps going flat, and in some cases the car shutting down or refusing to start.
issues.why: On this plug-in hybrid the 12-volt battery is charged from the big battery through a DC-DC converter instead of an alternator. When the converter fails, the 12V battery runs down. It sits inside the high-voltage battery unit, so dealers often replace the whole unit.
issues.next: Get it to a Honda dealer quickly and ask whether the repair falls under the hybrid component warranty, which is longer than the basic warranty.

issues.sym: The car will not power on, or the screens and locks act up, even though the big battery is charged.
issues.why: The small 12-volt battery that runs the computers and locks can wear out early. Owners report replacing it at around 20,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the 12V battery tested. If a new one also goes flat, have the charging system (DC-DC converter) checked.

issues.t: Hybrid system failure message, code P1D8D
issues.sym: A hybrid system warning on the dash display, possible loss of power, and code P1D8D stored.
issues.why: Honda issued a bulletin for a short circuit detected in the generator motor inverter, the electronics that control the motor that charges the battery.
issues.next: Pull over safely if power drops. Have a Honda dealer diagnose it using bulletin 21-008; this part is normally covered by the hybrid component warranty.

issues.t: Car won't start charging or stops charging early
issues.sym: You plug in but charging does not begin, or it stops before the battery is full.
issues.why: Honda issued a bulletin for both the Clarity Plug-In Hybrid and Clarity Electric covering charging that fails to start or ends early.
issues.next: Try another charger first. If it keeps happening, ask a Honda dealer to apply bulletin 18-097.

issues.t: Check engine light from engine computer software
issues.sym: Check engine light with codes such as P100C, P0010 or P26A3, with no change in how the car drives.
issues.why: A software problem in the engine computer (and the valve timing and coolant valve controls) sets false codes. Honda released updates and mailed owner letters.
issues.next: Have a Honda dealer confirm all software updates were done.

issues.t: Check engine light when the heater runs
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on during cold weather when you use the heat.
issues.why: A software problem in the climate control system can set a fault while the heater runs. Honda issued an update and an owner letter.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer to install the climate control update; up to three updates may be needed.

issues.t: Electric range display reads too high
issues.sym: The dash shows an unrealistic electric range, sometimes over 1,000 miles.
issues.why: A software error in the mileage calculation. Honda issued an update.
issues.next: Ignore the reading and have the update installed at a Honda dealer.

issues.t: Engine revs high with little acceleration
issues.sym: The gas engine roars at high rpm, for example on an on-ramp or hill, but the car speeds up slowly. Some owners say the engine starts even with plenty of battery left.
issues.why: Under heavy load the engine runs to make electricity for the drive motor, which can feel like slipping. Dealers often find no fault, but owners also report power loss.
issues.next: Note when it happens and the battery level. If power drops suddenly, have a dealer check for codes.

issues.sym: Pressing the fuel door button does nothing and you cannot get the door open to fill up.
issues.why: The fuel door on this plug-in hybrid opens electrically, and owners report it failing to release.
issues.next: Check the owner's manual for the manual release. Have the opener checked if it keeps happening.

issues.sym: A clicking or ticking noise from the dash when the fan runs.
issues.why: The climate control blower fan can make noise and need replacing.
issues.next: Have the blower checked for debris or a bad motor.

issues.t: LaneWatch or backup camera not working
issues.sym: The right-side LaneWatch camera image does not show, or the backup camera is slow to come on.
issues.why: Owners report camera failures on early cars.
issues.next: Have the camera and its connections checked under warranty if possible.

issues.t: Airbag warning light from SRS unit fault
issues.sym: The airbag (SRS) warning light stays on, with code U3000-49 stored.
issues.why: Honda released a service article listing several possible causes for an internal fault in the airbag control unit.
issues.next: Airbags may not work properly while this light is on. Have a Honda dealer diagnose it.

issues.sym: The gas engine may not start or may stall while driving.
issues.why: The fuel pump impeller can fail. Recall 23V858 covers many Hondas including the 2018-2019 Clarity.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the free fuel pump replacement done.

issues.t: Rear seat belts may not lock (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign; the rear belts may not lock to hold a child seat or passenger in a crash.
issues.why: A small number of 2019 cars got rear belts that may not lock properly. Recall 20V326 fixes them.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the dealer repair done before carrying passengers or child seats in back.

issues.t: Fuel cell can shut down and cut power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power or reduced power while driving.
issues.why: The fuel cell computer could mistake a small voltage dip for a fault and shut the system down. Recall 18V068 updated its software.
issues.next: Have an authorized Honda fuel cell dealer confirm the update was done.

issues.t: Fuel cell power loss after first software fix (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden partial or total loss of drive power.
issues.why: The first software fix did not cover every part of the fuel cell stack. Recall 18V921 installs a more complete update.
issues.next: Have one of Honda's authorized fuel cell dealers in California install the update.

issues.t: Water pump can corrode and stall the car (recall)
issues.sym: The car can suddenly lose drive power and stall.
issues.why: Internal parts of the water pump can corrode and fail. Recall 19V315 covers about 1,082 2017-2018 Clarity cars.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN and have the free dealer repair done.
